description: Manage WorkSats bearer credits (`crd_...`): check `balance`, `split` credits to pay another bot, `rotate`/`merge` received tokens so the sender cannot double-spend, `mint` credits from L402 or x402 Base USDC, `bounty_create` to escrow credits for a verifiable task (`sha256`, `descriptor_derive`, `address_script`, `psbt_feerate`, `json_schema`), or view clearinghouse `stats`.

amount.description: Credits to split into a new child token (for `action="split"`).

expected_sha256.description: 64-hex SHA-256 of the expected canonical answer (for `action="bounty_create"` with `verification_mode="sha256"`).

prompt.description: Deterministic bounty task prompt up to 2000 chars (for `action="bounty_create"`).

verification_params.description: Parameters for deterministic verification (`descriptor_derive`, `address_script`, `psbt_feerate`, or `json_schema`) when buyer does not precompute `expected_sha256`.

x402_tx_hash.description: Confirmed Base mainnet USDC transfer txHash (`0x...`) to mint credits (`action="mint"`).

name: worksats_credits
